plan.title: Split RFQ line items into lots

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the live RFQ lot-splitting flow.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose the lot-splitting action.

args.goal: In the open Split line items into lots screen, put lines 1 and 2 into Lot 1, put line 3 into Lot 2, save the split, and stop when the screen proves that two lots were created and the comparison shows Aggregate Lot Wise totals

steps.note: Perform the lot assignment and save operation that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Verify the comparison displays aggregate lot-wise totals after saving.
